title: Longest book per genre
statementMd:
For each genre show its longest book (genre, title, pages).

Expected columns: `genre`, `title`, `pages`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare to `MAX(pages)` of the same genre.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.genre, b.title, b.pages FROM books b WHERE b.pages = (SELECT MAX(b2.pages) FROM books b2 WHERE b2.genre = b.genre);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
